name: BMC Bioinformatics
fits_reason: Software articles usually demonstrate a significant advance by direct comparison with related software. This is a comparison/evidence standard, not a requirement for wet-lab work or a newly recruited cohort. The manuscript's comparative performance claim still depends on reconciling its scored runs.
speed_measure: submission-to-first-decision, median, not stated; includes editorial assessment and must not be described as external peer-review duration, not stated
ai_for_this_use: Allowed, but every use must be declared.
fee_route: List fee before VAT/local taxes. A 20% DEAL discount is available if the submitting corresponding author is an eligible Rostock researcher; university fund can pay at most EUR 2000 gross and remaining costs need grant/decentralised funds. Corresponding author and paper2 funding not confirmed; no zero author cost assumed.
preprint_rule: BMC permits any preprint server and licence; preprints are not prior publication. Disclose DOI/licence on submission and add the eventual publication reference. Potentially overlapping companion work must be declared and cited.

name: Bioinformatics (Original Paper)
fits_reason: Original Papers require actual biological data (simulation-only work needs an exceptional justification) and new methods need comparison with the state of the art. The paper has real literature-based cases, but no matched comparative performance baseline was located. No clinical-cohort or wet-lab requirement was found for this software article.
speed_measure: submission-to-first-decision (desk-inclusive), median, all manuscripts receiving a first decision, including desk rejections (OUP metric definition; reused same-day paper1 record), 2025
ai_for_this_use: Possibly a conflict for you to weigh: the journal bans AI drafting and does not say whether substantial rewording counts as drafting.
fee_route: Reused paper1's author-browser fee-calculator reading of 2026-10-19: same fee for Original Papers and Application Notes before tax, ISCB member discount 15%; no OUP agreement found there for Rostock/Romania. Paper2 grant coverage and corresponding-author eligibility unconfirmed; no euro comparison invented.
preprint_rule: The author's original preprint can be posted before submission; update its eventual published DOI. Related manuscripts (including under consideration elsewhere) must be disclosed in the cover letter, copied for editors, and distinguished. These rules allow separate companion papers; they do not require one paper's acceptance first.
